desc: 香槟金属管身，膏体微距与多肤色试色色带的唇部彩妆套图
name: 金属管身缎光显色唇膏款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用开盖立管与并列盖体交代管身装潢与膏体形态
承接主图，一秒交代上唇后的着色结果与膏体光泽
用膏体抹开的旋纹与光泽证明质地绵密，替代成分与功效说教
以闭合管身的镜面金属与腰封结构交代装潢做工，支撑质感卖点
把机制说明转成三枚留空论证位，真实资料在生成时才填入
shots.textZone: one headline line across the top and one short label beneath each of the three circular wells

shots.textZone: one clear headline band across the centre of the grid

shots.intent: 以管底标贴结构收口消除真伪与色号错发顾虑，全部字面留空待真实资料

style.backgroundSystem: seamless studio white #FFFFFF for packshots, macro textures and flat infographics, alternating with warm neutral matte panels #F4EDE6, thin champagne-metal frame lines #C9A96B on the framed screens
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and blank rounded pill labels outlined in champagne metal #C9A96B, no filled illustrative icons
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light, front-left softbox key with fill card, butterfly beauty light on skin crops, controlled narrow speculars on the polished metal, soft contact shadows only
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent polished champagne-metal lipstick visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless studio white #FFFFFF, warm neutral matte #F4EDE6, champagne metal #C9A96B and charcoal text #33302E, with bullet and lip color always carried by one accent placeholder; bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left softbox key and fill, butterfly light on skin crops, controlled narrow speculars on polished metal and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif typography only; thin single-weight line icons and blank rounded pill labels; stable upright tube scale and placement with one long vertical highlight on the case; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no fixed lip shade hue across the set
style.presentationRules: tube kept upright and at a stable scale across the set, one long vertical highlight on each face of the polished case, bullet and lip color always carried by the accent placeholder rather than a fixed hue
style.surfaceSystem: seamless white sweep and warm matte board #F4EDE6, flat overhead surface, no visible table edge or horizon
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for every headline, label and small-print line, one family only; all in-image copy supplied as placeholders at generation time
